name: Soleil Boutique Hotel Hanoi
detail: The location is only a 5-minute walk from the north side of Train Street and a 5-minute walk to the Klook Halong Bay tour pickup point at Hanoi Tower. It's about a 10-15 minute walk from Hanoi Station and a 20-30 minute walk to the night market and Dong Xuan Market, making it very convenient. Breakfast is included, and there were many easy-to-eat options, including pho. Wi-Fi connection works without any problems. The shower and washroom are clean, and hot water comes out normally. It's not a large hotel, but during breakfast and checkout times, the elevators can be narrow and take a while to arrive. There were no Asians staying during my visit, which was unusual for a hotel. There is a gym and pool area, but it's best not to have high expectations. Free bottled water is provided every day. Due to its convenient location, the accommodation costs are a bit high, but I am satisfied.
area: Hoan Kiem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Palette Ngoc Ha Luxury Residence
detail: A worthwhile choice with a clean space, full amenities, and well-cared rooms. The bathroom is tidy, Wi-Fi works well, and transportation is quite convenient. The staff is friendly and very helpful, providing a comfortable stay experience. The location is fairly decent, although not the most convenient.

name: Townhouse Starlake Residence
detail: The room is clean, airy, new, and odor-free, but the location is a bit inconvenient for my commute to work. The staff here are enthusiastic in assisting customers, welcoming guests, and providing quick support.
area: Tu Liem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Madelise Palace Hotel & Spa
detail: The hotel has just been renovated and upgraded, so the facilities are still new, the rooms are spacious, clean, and comfortable. The space is airy, and the room size is good compared to many other hotels. It is definitely worth choosing for your stay. I recommend everyone to experience it!

name: Hanoi Railway Capsule
detail: This is a place where you can stay安心 regardless of the length of your stay. The staff is trustworthy, and you can easily consult them about anything. Upon check-in, you will be shown to your own shoe locker and locker. At that time, you can also borrow sandals. The area with rooms in the building is air-conditioned, and there are fans both in the rooms and in the dining area. The beds in the rooms are large, and there are sliding doors and curtains, so you don’t have to worry about privacy. For safety, there are surveillance cameras installed inside the building, and the gates are locked at night, providing peace of mind. Breakfast is provided every day in a paper bag and is placed in front of your room. You can eat at any time you like, allowing you to move at your own pace. Convenience stores, food stalls, dining spots, and tourist attractions are all within walking distance. If you know the way, you can reach it from Hanoi Station in about 10 to 15 minutes. The cost performance is good, and it's cheap yet clean and safe. You can use this accommodation as a base to join day tours or excursions to the suburbs. You need to bring your own bath towels, while shampoo and body soap are provided in the shower room. There’s also a laundry nearby, so large laundry items are not a problem. The staff is really kind and helped me during my stay.

name: Signature by M Village Thợ Nhuộm, a brand of Modern Village Lifestyle
detail: It is very clean and the staff is extremely friendly. The swimming pool is great for sauna and exercise, and the gym operates 24 hours. The best part is the laundry service that is free for 24 hours with detergent provided. As a long-term traveler, I really appreciated it. The downside is that the room is a bit small, but there's no problem unfolding a suitcase. Also, on long-stay bookings, they clean the room but don't change the sheets. Still, they clean it very well. The bathroom is small, haha. Overall, for this price, the quality is excellent. The location is perfect with not a single ant, which is rare in Southeast Asia! I highly recommend it.
area: Hoan Kiem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Hôtel de Rond Au Lac Hanoi
detail: Excellent, this is the best hotel I have ever stayed at in Vietnam. I will recommend it to all my friends who travel to Vietnam. I originally planned to stay for one day, but because the stay was so comfortable, I extended it for two more days. I was worried when I saw that there were no ratings for this hotel on Agoda, but since I passed by it while exploring the Old Town, I decided to check in. All the staff are amazing, and although my English is poor, they used a translator to communicate with me. The breakfast is delicious, with a wide variety. The room is particularly clean, and the staff are very patient.

name: Delica Premium Hotel
detail: Excellent location, right in the old quarter of Hanoi, you can walk to Hoan Kiem Lake and nearby snack shops. The room is clean and tidy, and the air conditioning is very effective; it's quiet for sleeping. Breakfast is served on the first floor from 7 to 9 AM, with simple and tasty options. The front desk staff are friendly, communication is smooth, and they patiently help resolve any issues. Overall, it's very cost-effective, perfect for a short overnight stay, and I will choose to stay again next time I come to Hanoi. Highly recommended!

name: Hanoi Hotel
detail: The breakfast is excellent, and there are many fluent speakers of English and Korean everywhere. The room service and the staff's service are outstanding. I always felt taken care of, whether it was having the door opened and closed when entering and exiting, receiving bright greetings, or the cleaning. The amenities are also more than adequate. The bedding is neat, and everything is very satisfying.

name: Tru by Hilton Hanoi Station
detail: The room is very clean, especially the bedding is comfortable. I think the hotel should add a comb to the amenities to cater to female guests.
